paper_001.title: Data-driven systematic parameter identification of an electrochemical model for lithium-ion batteries with artificial intelligence
relevant_points: AI-assisted optimization used current and voltage data with multi-objective loss
Sensitivity-based multi-step identification improves weakly sensitive parameters
Reported RMSE around 9 mV for constant-current and 12.7 mV for driving cycles

paper_003.title: Parameter Identification of Lithium-Ion Batteries Model to Predict Discharge Behaviors Using Heuristic Algorithm
relevant_points: Heuristic divide-and-conquer parameter identification to reduce search time
Parameter grouping is useful when many electrochemical parameters are weakly identifiable

paper_002.title: Modeling of Galvanostatic Charge and Discharge of the Lithium/Polymer/Insertion Cell
relevant_points: Foundational physics basis for diffusion-limited galvanostatic discharge behavior
Supports use of interpretable transport and solid-diffusion parameters in simplified simulators

notes: paper_000 text extraction was corrupted/unusable; not relied upon
